title: Stacked Tomato and Burrata Salad
description: Chef John’s gorgeous twist on caprese salad features rich, creamy Burrata cheese (not mozzarella!) sandwiched between juicy, fresh tomato slices.
ingredients: 1 vine-ripened tomato, cored and cut into 1/2-inch slices
flaked sea salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
0.25 cup burrata cheese, or more to taste
1 tablespoon torn fresh basil leaves, or to taste

steps.text: Place a tomato slice onto a plate and season with sea salt and black pepper. Spread Burrata cheese over tomato slice, top with torn basil leaves, and drizzle with olive oil. Repeat the layering process with remaining ingredients, finishing with a tomato slice.

video.description: In this video, you’ll see how to make a tomato and burrata salad. Stack it up! Spreading buttery burrata cheese between layers of tomato slices and beautiful fresh basil. Salt and pepper generously and drizzle with good quality olive oil. That's all there is to it! It’s not just a tomato and mozzarella salad. As Chef John says, “Comparing mozzarella and burrata is a little unfair, as burrata is significantly richer and creamier.”
